text: Decider map, four minutes on the clock. A cat strolls through {player}'s room and sits down on the keyboard. {player} does not move the cat, because "he'll get bored and leave on his own".

choices.label: Go move the cat yourself
choices.detail: You burst into the room in the middle of the stream. Three hundred thousand people now know what your boxers look like.

choices.label: Let it happen
choices.detail: {player} plays one-handed. You will probably lose. But if you win, it is the meme of the season.
